explanations.title: Explanation
texts: 1. It is possible to apply for the "POLSKA" award in one or more categories on one application form. The same applies to applications for increasing the class of the awards already possessed, or to stickers for the awards already possessed. Joint applications, i.e. applications for new categories of the awards together with applications for increasing the class of the award(s) are also acceptable.

2. The "POLSKA" award is issued in 15 categories, in each category separately, i.e. on a separate application form. It is so, because the fee for the award specified in the "General rules" is the fee for the award in one category (for one copy). (See here: http://www.awards.pzk.org.pl/general-rules.html

3. The fee for each copy of the award is 5 EUR or 7 USD or 5 IRCs – sent with an application. The fee for stickers is 1 EUR or 1 USD or 1 IRC. This fee applies to any number of stickers on an award(s) sent in a single mail.

4. Contacts listed in specifications should be sorted firstly according to the letters marking a voivodship, and afterwards – within particular voivodships – according to the bands. The rules of GCR lists apply – compliance of a list of contacts with QSL cards confirmed by two fully licensed amateurs. It applies to any sheet of specification.

5. An application for the award(s) together with specifications of contacts should be sent to:
Award Manager PZK
Wiesław T. Postawka - SQ9V
P. O. Box 53
44-280 RYDUŁTOWY
Poland
or
Award Manager PZK
PZK HQ Secretariat
P. O. Box 54
85-613 BYDGOSZCZ 13
Poland
